source_decisions.decision: Readable-local216-334 is now read, alongside1-215/335-350: visual descendants, optional pnlOperBtns-only list when nonempty, exact case-insensitive button-name classes, and DisableButton. Permission object flags are assigned false inside matching button branches rather than independently from every permission row. No document-key or branch-membership decision is returned.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: GetBool returns false on missing/invalid value, not true. Missing permission rows/outer exceptions and default-true constructor are different paths. No tree realization, SDK inheritance, denial enforcement or whole-application ACL is certified.

source_decisions.decision: The supplied InsertReceipt initializer names29 parameters; SaveReceipt2 explicitly binds28. @Recipient is missing even after casefold comparison. This discrepancy is local and cannot be externalized as unknown provider behavior or fixed by a model constructor adding a command parameter.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: SaveReceipt2 does have its own try/rollback/finally and Commit-before-true. Connection opening/BeginTransaction precede its try. Other case-sensitive parameter names, types, constructor/default values and deployed SQL behavior were not accepted. InsertReceipt is a public mutable field; no runtime field substitution is claimed.

source_decisions.decision: Q/VAT source deletes directly. D/QD/SD conditionally delete after true from a SaveReceipt2 transaction on another fresh-global connection. The caller deletes through its retained connection without sharing that transaction, and the deletion predicate includes id but not branch. No atomic migrate-plus-delete or retry/idempotence certificate follows. QD/SD generate a new GlobalID by branch MAX(AutoID)+1 and choose the first Entry match by local id+branch without type.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: The supplied legacy CREATE fragments show no PK/unique rule on these id columns; that is not deployed duplicate evidence. No deletion, commit, migration success, provider exception or lost row was observed. D omits explicit initialization of several consumed Receipt properties; unavailable constructor semantics are not fabricated.

source_decisions.decision: Both note INSERT/UPDATE SQL texts omit BranchId. The credit Add(@BranchId) is not a column write because no SQL placeholder uses it; the debt binder does not add it. UPDATE/soft-delete predicates use Doc_Type+Doc_No; the Entry write/read/delete still use current branch/global key separately. SaveEnty owns a fresh connection/transaction and commits before the outer note transaction; no rollback coupling is proved.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: Doc_No generation is global per Doc_Type, not per branch, and the supplied table has an Id PK with nullable BranchId. No collision/wrong note or deployed BranchId default/trigger was observed or ruled out. LoadNxtNo/LoadNextNumber use adapters without passing the outer transaction, and catch their errors; no actual provider failure is inferred.

source_decisions.source_basis: Every original17 R7 source site remains paired below; source/reader hashes point to the frozen core facts. Branch loader/filter contexts and User operation17 provenance were now read locally.
source_decisions.decision: A syntactically branch-scoped request, a selected branch UI control or FormPermission button list is not a user/document allowed-set. Customer Loaded subsequently writes chkAllBranches=true; its collector can send an empty branch filter and ShowAccount directly interpolates that filter. No independent Accounting.BranchCondition is added there. The Changed handler and LoadAccounts/BuildAccountsQuery do not restore the boolean or a second Entry filter.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: Source predicates are qualified per route, not a blanket missing-ACL claim. Original invoice/receipt branch predicates, user operation17 state, purchase own permission call, note-global numbering, and the distinct Initial/New detail policies are retained. No unauthorized document opening, server-policy absence or whole D17 exit is certified.
